```{r}
# Read in and Clean ALL S2W CSVs
s2w_replies_file_paths <- list.files(
  path = r"(C:\Users\Ruairi\Documents\Coding Projects 2025\ct04_testing\S2W Replies and Responses Jan 15 6pm)",
  pattern = "replies.*\\.csv$", # Matches "replies" or "Replies" followed by anything and ending in .csv
  full.names = TRUE
)
s2w_replies <- map_dfr(s2w_replies_file_paths, read_csv, .id = "source_file")

s2w_replies_grouped_by_msg <- s2w_replies %>% 
  group_by(`Contact Phone Number`) %>% 
  summarise(n=n(), full_convo = paste(`Message Text`, collapse = "\n\n[NEXT MESSAGE]\n\n")) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n))

s2w_results_file_paths <- list.files(
  path = r"(C:\Users\Ruairi\Documents\Coding Projects 2025\ct04_testing\S2W Replies and Responses Jan 15 6pm)",
  pattern = "results.*\\.csv$", # Matches "replies" or "Replies" followed by anything and ending in .csv
  full.names = TRUE
)
s2w_results <- map_dfr(s2w_results_file_paths, read_csv, .id = "source_file")

```


```{r GoogleSheetTransferQual}
df_convos <- left_join(s2w_results, s2w_replies_grouped_by_msg, by = "Contact Phone Number") %>% 
  select(
    -c(`source_file`, `Campaign ID`, `Carrier`, `Contact Script Message Type`, `Contact Script Media URL`, `Contact Script Variant ID`, `Donation Amount`)
    ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n), full_convo) %>% 
  filter(n > 1)
```

## Convert Addresses to Lat/Long for Tagged Respondents

Should we include OPT OUTS here too??

```{r}
# Convert addresses to lat/long coordinates
df_adds_to_convert <- texted_with_vf_info  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(tags_reconciled)) %>% 
  mutate(full_address = paste(address_number, ' ', street_name, ' ', town_name.y, ', ', state, ' ', zip5 , sep = ''))

add_lat_long <- function(df_adds){   
  batch_size <- 500
  batches <- split(df_adds, ceiling(seq_len(nrow(df_adds)) / batch_size))
  
  results <- purrr::map_dfr(batches, ~{
    Sys.sleep(0.2)        # optional
   tidygeocoder::geocode(
        .x,      
        address = full_address,
        method = "osm", #Capitalization matters!  # osm: Uses OpenStreetMap's Nominatim API, census: Good for well-formatted, U.S. addresses #ArcGIS
        # full_results = TRUE # Gives confidence 0-100
      ) %>%
      rename(lat_osm = lat, long_osm = long) 
  })
  return(results)
} 

texted_with_vf_info_lat_long <- add_lat_long(df_adds_to_convert)
second_conversion <- add_lat_long(texted_with_vf_info_lat_long %>% filter(is.na(lat_census)))

df_map_lat_long <- left_join(texted_with_vf_info_lat_long, second_conversion %>% select(voter_id, lat_osm, long_osm), by = join_by(voter_id)) 

df_map_lat_long_no_NA <- df_map_lat_long %>% mutate(lat = coalesce(lat_census, lat_osm), long = coalesce(long_census, long_osm)) %>% filter(!is.na(lat))
```

```{r}
c_map <- c(
  "Yes"   = "green",   
  "Maybe" = "orange",     
  "No"    = "darkred",     
  "INFO"  = "blue"        
)

icons <- awesomeIcons(
  icon = "user",
  iconColor = "white",
  markerColor = unname(c_map[as.character(df_map_lat_long_no_NA$tags_reconciled)]) #Removes the name from a vector
)

df_map_lat_long_no_NA %>% 
  leaflet() %>%
    addTiles() %>%
    addAwesomeMarkers(
      lng = ~long, 
      lat = ~lat,
      icon = icons,
      popup = ~paste0("<b>Address:</b> ", full_address, "<br>",
                "<b>Age:</b> ", age.y, "<br>",
                "<b>Gender:</b> ", gender.y, "<br>",
                "<b>Town:</b> ", town_name.y, "<br>",
                "<b>Voter ID:</b> ", voter_id, "<br>",
                "<b>First:</b> ", first_name.y, "<br>",
                "<b>Last:</b> ", last_name.y, "<br>",
                "<b>Tag:</b>", tags_reconciled)
    )
```
